attributes.body_ja:
「(A) に関係（かんけい）なく」や「(A) でもそうじゃなくても」と言（い）いたいとき、「に関（かか）わらず」という表現（ひょうげん）がよく使（つか）われます。これは「に」と五段動詞（ごだんどうし）「関（かか）わる」、そして文語（ぶんご）助動詞（じょどうし）「ず」（意味（いみ）：ない）の組（く）み合（あ）わせです。

この文型（ぶんけい）は、辞書形（じしょけい）や否定形（ひていけい）の動詞（どうし）や形容詞（けいようし）、または名詞（めいし）と一緒（いっしょ）に使（つか）われます。また、同（おな）じ言葉（ことば）が肯定形（こうていけい）と否定形（ひていけい）で繰（く）り返（かえ）されたり、「(A) かそうじゃないか」という意味（いみ）を強（つよ）めるために「かどうか」という表現（ひょうげん）と一緒（いっしょ）に使（つか）われることもよくあります。

この表現（ひょうげん）の「(A) に関係（かんけい）なく (B)」という意味（いみ）は、(B) が (A) の影響（えいきょう）を受（う）けずに起（お）こること、存在（そんざい）することを表（あらわ）しています。そのため、「に関（かか）わらず」は「(A) が何（なん）であっても、(B) という結果（けっか）は同（おな）じだ」という表現（ひょうげん）として使（つか）われることもあります。
attributes.body:
In order to convey 'regardless of (A)', 'no matter if (A)', or 'with or without (A)', the expression に関（かか）わらず will often be used. This is a combination of に, the う-Verb 関（かか）わる 'to be affected', 'to be influenced', and the literary auxiliary verb ず, which connects with verbs in the same way, and carries the same meaning as ない.

This structure may be seen with verbs or adjectives in either their dictionary or negative forms, or with nouns. Frequently the same word is repeated in both the positive and the negative, or grouped with かどうか in order to strengthen the 'whether (A) or not (A)' nuance.

As the literal meaning of this structure is 'without being influenced by (A), (B)', or 'without being affected by (A), (B)', the primary nuance is on the fact that (B) is something that exists or will happen without consideration for (A). Due to this, に関（かか）わらず may also be used to show that 'any type of (A) will result in the same (B)'.

attributes.source: 新完全マスター文法 N2

attributes.description: The difference between `にかかわらず` and `にもかかわらず`
を問わず VS にかかわらず

attributes.body: Both mean regardless of, but differ slightly in register. にかかわらず is more formal or literary, often used even with negative implications, as in 年齢にかかわらず (Regardless of age). を問わず is more common in daily usage, treating conditions equally without preference, as in 学歴を問わず (Regardless of academic background).

attributes.body: にかかわらず means regardless of or whether or not, as in 年齢にかかわらず (Regardless of age). にもかかわらず means in spite of and highlights contradiction between expectation and reality, often with surprise, as in 雨にもかかわらず人が集まった (In spite of the rain, people gathered).

attributes.body: ～ても～なくても and にかかわらず both express that something holds regardless of condition. ～ても～なくても contrasts an action with its negative, e.g. 行っても行かなくても ('whether you go or not'), while にかかわらず can attach to a single noun, e.g. 天気にかかわらず ('regardless of the weather'), or a pair of opposing concepts, e.g. 早いか遅いかに関わらず ('whether early or late').

second_relatable.title: にかかわらず
second_relatable.meaning: Regardless of, Whether or, No matter, With or without

attributes.body: どうしても and にかかわらず both mean 'no matter' or 'regardless of', but differ in usage. どうしても appears at the beginning of a sentence to express strong will or inevitability. For example, どうしても勝ちたい ('I want to win no matter what'). にかかわらず usually follows nouns or question phrases and shows that something remains unchanged regardless of conditions. For example, 年齢にかかわらず参加できます ('You can participate regardless of age').
